Stop 2: Café Avra (First visit, prospect pitch ready)
Stop 3: Bistro Lofos (Hasn't ordered in 12 days; offer expires tomorrow)

Campaign of the week: Espresso Nuovo to cafés, until 21/11
Target revenue: 1633 of 18000 EUR (9%), 15 days left

script_text: Hi Nikos! Here's your briefing. Stop 1 is Café Miltos. There's an open issue with grinder noise, and the espresso deal is still on the table. Stop 2 is Café Avra. It's a first visit, and your prospect pitch is ready. Stop 3 is Bistro Lofos. They haven't ordered in 12 days, and the offer expires tomorrow. Stop 4 is Mini Market Elena, just a routine visit. Stop 5 is Fournos Gonia, a new prospect bakery. Now, a promise to keep in mind: the Bistro Lofos offer expires, so follow up tomorrow. The campaign of the week is Espresso Nuovo to cafés, running until 21/11. On your targets: revenue is 1633 of 18000 EUR, that's 9%, with 15 days left. Visits are 6 of 110, which is 6%, also with 15 days left. Shall we start with Café Miltos?
